records.name: Royal Titans, Barrows, and Corrupted Gauntlet factual access boundaries
records.scope: Normalized high-value factual access, encounter, recovery, and reward boundaries for three PvM activities. Practical readiness, gear, supplies, competence, wins, loot, drop targets, and timing remain player-observed strategy questions.

royal_titans.formal_access: Members-only; no formal quest, skill, or combat requirement is listed. The north-west Asgarnian Ice Dungeon approach is the default route; the 60 Agility shortcut and a charged Giantsoul amulet are optional arrival alternatives.
royal_titans.encounter_boundary: Instanced Eldric and Branda encounter with melee, Ranged, and Magic/barrier mechanics. Solo or group participation, contribution, tactics, damage, survival, and outcomes are not inferred.
royal_titans.recovery_boundary: Instance death places unprotected items at a grave outside the entrance; ground items in the instance are lost. A recovery plan remains account-specific.
royal_titans.reward_boundary: A completed encounter permits a player choice of Titan loot, but all regular and unique rewards remain RNG and must be observed.

barrows.formal_access: Members-only; Priest in Peril completion is required for Morytania and His Faithful Servants must be started to dig into the crypts.
barrows.encounter_boundary: Six crypt encounters, run-specific tunnel state, door spawns, and escalating underground Prayer drain are encounter mechanics, not readiness proof.
barrows.recovery_boundary: Death and recovery use the ordinary grave system; player-specific travel, items, fee, reachability, and recovery result remain observed.
barrows.reward_boundary: At least one enemy must be killed for chest loot. Brother kills affect the possible equipment pool and reward rolls, while all chest contents remain RNG.

corrupted_gauntlet.formal_access: Song of the Elves completion grants Gauntlet access; at least one completed normal Gauntlet is required before Corrupted Gauntlet can be attempted. The normal-completion unlock is explicitly confirmed rather than inferred from skills or gear.
corrupted_gauntlet.encounter_boundary: The activity supplies its preparation resources and equipment in-instance. Corrupted preparation, style switching, protection-prayer cycle, tornado movement, and floor hazards remain player-observed.
corrupted_gauntlet.recovery_boundary: External gear is not taken into the activity. Hardcore status risk and Ultimate Ironman instanced-bank risk remain explicit account-type concerns.
corrupted_gauntlet.reward_boundary: Only completion gives unique-reward rolls; all seed, shard, chest, cape, and failure outcomes remain observations.
